messages:
samir: Quick follow-up from last night's GPU surge postmortem — want to lock owners/timelines for remediation items before EOD.

linda: I'm free to take scheduler tuning work (reduce preemption churn). Can we scope exact changes?

devin: I can own quota backstop changes (increase reserved headroom for critical tiers). Need signoff from finance for committed spend.

kevin: Ops bot created the initial action checklist: ops-bot: Created task GPU-1253 (headroom baseline), GPU-1254 (scheduler preemption), GPU-1255 (quota alerts).

maria: Request: add a quick regression test so we catch the pattern earlier. I can sketch a load test harness.

samir: Agreement plan:
- Owner: devin -> GPU-1253 (reserve extra 10% headroom for premium tier) -> deadline 2026-04-02
- Owner: linda -> GPU-1254 (adjust scheduler preemption thresholds + tidy policies) -> deadline 2026-03-29
- Owner: maria -> GPU-1256 (synthetic surge regression test in CI) -> deadline 2026-03-27
- Owner: kevin -> GPU-1255 (pager/alert tuning for quota exhaustion) -> deadline 2026-03-30

kevin: For GPU-1255 I'll push an alert that triggers at 85% committed GPU usage (not total) and a second at 95% with runbooks. Will also add a slack escalation hook.

linda: On scheduler: proposed changes (short):
```
- increase min_headroom to 12% for dedicated pools
- add a soft cap preemption window (5s) to avoid thrash
- prefer local host assignment for low-latency requests
```
I'll open a PR with metrics pre/post.

devin: On cost: finance ok for temporary headroom if we have a rollback plan. I'll draft options: (a) 10% reserved, (b) burst credits w/ autoscale limits.

maria: For regression test, I'll create a Jenkins/Argo job that runs a 30m surge at different seq lengths and checks autoscale headroom usage. Will include KV-cache warmup.

samir: Two operational notes: 1) make sure Dedicated customers get a config flag to opt-out of headroom changes; 2) schedule a weekly 15m incident-pattern sync for next 6 weeks to watch recurrence.

kevin: Noted on opt-out. I'll add a customer-facing doc blurb and opt-out toggle in admin console (tracking ticket ADMIN-88).

linda: I'll run a 6-hour canary after PR merges, invite @sre-oncall to validate.

ops-bot: Reminder: next check-in meeting scheduled 2026-03-25T16:00Z.

samir: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate these into the postmortem follow-ups doc and ping owners again tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

maria: acked.

devin: ack.

kevin: ack.
